title: Top notch Priorat experience
text: Our tour to Priorat with Ariadna was absolutely perfect in every way. She is a great driver which is relaxing from the start. She is educated in wine and we were able to spend the drive to Priorat in comfort while chatting about wine, the history of the region and geography. We loved the wineries that Kevin selected for our tour. Sagenis Vaque was a delight as we enjoyed local cheeses and hazelnuts while tasting wine at the top of the vineyard. We had a huge lunch at Clos Figueras, closing the day at Scala Dei with a relaxed and educational tasting. We were able to purchase wine both to carry

title: Incredibly enjoyable for wine snobs
text:
I did Wino Tours’ Priorat tour. As a solo traveller doing his WSET level 3, it was exactly what I was looking for. Ahead of the tour day, the communication from Kevin was clear and organised - I felt very much at ease that they had everything under control. On the day, Joan picked me up close to my hotel in a comfortable van. He was very personable and clearly knows the region and its wine intimately. It was great to hear that he grew up in the wine industry, and it added a great deal of authority to his expertise. He’s by far one of the most enjoyable guides I’ve travelled with.

title: MEMORABLE
text: We went on this tour with Ivan and it was AMAZING from beginning to end!! He picked us up from our hotel and took us to 3 very different Priorat wineries (for wine, not sparkling/cava) and we even had the opportunity to do one of our 3 wine tastings in the mountains! It was fun, interesting, entertaining and genuinely authentic. All in all, a memorable experience!! So if you have the chance, do not hesitate to book it!
